description: Reproducible model to compare individual and coordinated demand response with dynamic and static power grid tariffs is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Stian Backe. This dataset supports reproduction of the analysis of cost minimizing flexibility responses with different subscription-based grid tariffs presented in the associated paper ". The analysis is designed to identify successful characteristics of a capacity-based grid tariff to trigger efficient development and utilization of the power grid given consumers with some flexibility cost minimizing their bills. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
